Blue-hour twilight, cool diffuse cobalt settling across the full brick range, the very last warm-amber rim light catching only the highest ridge crest stud row, deep blue-violet pooling in the canyon floor plates.
Blue-hour cool indigo overhead, every brick face registering a flat cold blue-grey tone, the faintest warm-amber remnant tracing the uppermost snow-cap tile edge against a darkening sky backdrop.

Blue-hour post-sunset diffuse cobalt-blue, shadowless across the entire stepped brick landscape, trans-clear ice-element peaks reading as pale cold grey, lower pine-element canopies merging into deep navy.

Twilight blue-hour, a thin cool cyan-blue wash from camera-upper-left, barely separating the mid-range brick plates from the dark base tier, no hard shadows, only a soft tonal gradient down the slope.

Storm-light god-ray sunbeam breaking from a dark bley cloud-brick bank directly overhead, a narrow warm-yellow shaft hitting the central peak tile at steep angle, surrounding brick faces remaining in cold storm-shadow.

Lightning-strike accent — a trans-yellow and trans-white bolt element flashing from a dark-bley storm-cloud plate overhead, cold electric-white light momentarily flooding the ridge front in hard flat shock illumination.

Storm dramatic side-ray, a single warm-gold god-ray shaft breaking from a left-side cloud-brick gap, slicing diagonally across the mid-range brick terrace, leaving the right canyon wall in deep grey-green storm shadow.

Midday harsh overhead sun, short stubby hard shadows directly beneath every protruding brick ledge and pine-element bough, the upper plateau tiles bleached near-white, lower vertical brick faces reading deep grey.
Midday high-angle bright white sun from directly above, every horizontal stud surface over-exposed pale, all vertical brick faces in sharp high-contrast shadow, no directional sweep across the range.

Midday harsh bright sun slightly off center-left, short asymmetric hard shadows falling right off every stepped ledge plate, snow-cap trans-white elements flaring near-blown-out against dark pine-element green.
Midday overhead harsh white-yellow, small hard shadow blocks collecting on the downhill side of each brick tier, the full upper ridge face reading raw tan and white with no warm-tone offset.

Overcast flat diffuse cool grey-blue from overhead, every brick face across the full range receiving identical even illumination, no shadow lines, trans-clear ice peaks reading pale neutral grey against a white sky plate.

Overcast diffuse cool silver-grey blanketing the entire brick landscape from upper-left, pine-element canopies appearing dark hunter-green, brick valley floor tiles registering a uniform cool mid-tone with zero shadow.

Flat overcast cool blue-grey, even light touching every stepped terrace plate and ridge stud simultaneously, no tonal gradient across elevation levels, trans-blue water-element tiles blending into the grey-lit base.

Overcast even cool grey, the upper snow-cap white tiles nearly indistinguishable from the pale sky backdrop plate, all pine-element boughs sitting in flat even dark green with no directional highlight.
Dawn sunrise low pink-amber side-light from far camera-left, warm rose-gold kissing the left face of every stepped brick tier, right-side vertical faces still holding cool dark blue pre-dawn shadow.

Sunrise low amber from camera-left horizon, thin pink-gold light raking across the brick range base-to-peak, mist-element trans-white plates softening the valley floor while upper ridgeline studs catch crisp warm highlight.
Dawn low side-light, soft pink-amber from camera-right horizon, warm pastel rose touching each exposed peak tile and snow-cap edge, the left canyon wall remaining in cool pre-dawn lavender shadow.

Moonlit silver-blue from upper-right, faint cool light tracing only the topmost ridge-line brick edges and snow-cap tile surfaces in pale silver, the entire valley floor sinking into deep cool navy shadow.

Moonlit full-moon overhead, cold silver-blue washing the upper plateau and peak tiles in pale metallic sheen, mid-range brick terraces holding medium-deep blue-grey, canyon floor completely lost in near-black shadow.

Moonlit low-angle silver from camera-left, cool blue-white rim tracing the left edge of every protruding ledge plate and pine-element canopy top, right-side brick faces falling into deep indigo-black shadow.

Aurora northern-lights — trans-green and trans-purple sky-band plates overhead, diffuse cool green-tinted top-light washing the peak tile snow-caps, purple-edge glow fringing the upper ridge stud row in faint violet.

Aurora overhead, shifting trans-green and trans-purple element band casting a cool bicolor wash across the full brick range, snow-cap tiles picking up green-white highlight, canyon floor reading deep purple-black.

Aurora northern-lights sky, trans-green dominant overhead with trans-purple accent at the far edge, the upper brick plateau tiles registering cool green-grey, lower pine-element canopies absorbing purple-green ambient fringe.

Alpenglow pink-amber, post-sunset warm rose light sourced from a low right-horizon sky-plate, striking only the uppermost snow-cap and peak tiles in saturated pink-orange while all lower brick tiers fall into cool blue-grey.

Alpenglow pre-dawn from camera-left, deep rose-amber grazing the topmost brick ridge row and trans-white snow-cap tiles in saturated pink, the entire mid and lower range brick face remaining in pre-dawn cool shadow.

Rainbow rain-after — a trans-arc brick rainbow element arching from camera-left to camera-right, a warm sun-shaft from upper-left illuminating the wet brick terrace tiles in bright yellow-white while the arc casts split color across the valley.

Post-rain rainbow, a trans-arc element spanning the full brick range width, warm sun-shaft from camera-right side-lighting the wet stud surfaces in amber-white, the rainbow arc projecting faint prismatic color bands across the valley floor tiles.

Starlight deep-night, an overhead trans-black sky plate studded with pinpoint trans-clear elements providing only the faintest ghostly ambient light, peak tile snow-caps barely visible as pale grey forms against total darkness.

Deep-night starfield overhead, faint diffuse cool blue-black ambient from massed trans-clear star elements, ridge brick silhouette barely readable as dark charcoal shapes, valley floor tiles completely absorbed in near-total dark.

Volcanic glow, trans-orange lava-element light sourced from a low camera-right fissure plate, warm orange-red underlight striking all lower brick tier faces from below, upper peak tiles catching a faint hot-orange rim against dark sky.

Blizzard white-out, a featureless near-pure-white flat light from all directions simultaneously, every brick face, snow-cap tile, and pine-element canopy collapsing into a near-uniform pale grey-white with no shadow or highlight direction.

Ice-shelf caustic glow from a trans-cyan glacier element plate at the base-left, cool cyan-teal underlight bouncing upward across the lower brick terrace faces in rippled bright patches, mid-range plates tinting to cool aqua-grey.
